evidence.quote: Serum voriconazole concentrations in mice given grapefruit juice

Male BALB/cByJ mice (weight not reported), intranasal Blastomyces dermatitidis. Drinking water replaced by GRAPEFRUIT JUICE (about "2 to 3 ml of grapefruit juice/day") from 5 days before infection to raise exposure (CYP inhibition).
Oral gavage in 4% PEG 400, 5, 20 or 40 mg/kg daily or 40 mg/kg three times a week, from day 5 after infection for 21 days. Serum agar-well bioassay (C. kefyr), standard curve 0.6125-10 μg/ml.

Footnote a: "Values are means ± standard deviations of values obtained from six mice at each time point. Blood was obtained on day 11 (midtreatment, approximately 4 h after dosing) and day 23, 2 days after treatment was stopped. Day 11 was Thursday, and thus, mice in the group that received voriconazole at 40 mg/kg three times per week (on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays) received voriconazole approximately 24 h earlier."

findings.reason: MI005 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy. This page supports candidate preparation of rows A98:C101 as group-summary PK records, but a DC-label classification does not complete the authorized preparation review or establish final record usability. DR02 metadata remain incomplete: chemical dose basis, total versus unbound basis, verified experimental-unit structure, detection-limit definitions and complete dose-event history are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Authorized preparation and independent coverage review recording row-level usability decisions, reasons and unresolved gaps; preserve MI005 until its responsible gate records an explicit outcome.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T8:A95 states dosing 'from day 5 after infection for 21 days', whereas A96 describes day 23 as '2 days after treatment was stopped'. Their time origins and compatibility are not established. Day-11 sampling also differs by regimen: approximately 4 h after dosing generally, but approximately 24 h after dosing for the three-times-per-week group.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported clarification of the day numbering, treatment start and stop, and regimen-specific last-dose times. Retain both statements unchanged pending review.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T8:A95 identifies a serum agar-well bioassay and standard curve 0.6125-10 μg/ml. It does not define LOD, LLOQ, ULOQ, censoring policy or total versus unbound concentration basis. The standard-curve endpoints cannot be adopted as detection or quantification limits. No missing-value or BLQ markers are present in the supplied body cells.
findings.needed_material: Authorized assay-limit, censoring and analyte-basis definitions if required for preparation or downstream interpretation; retain unspecified fields as NOT_FOUND.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs comprise source-typed serum means ± standard deviations for four regimens at day 11 and day 23. Exact sampling times, actual dosing events, individual identifiers and serial versus destructive sampling are NOT_FOUND. The two days represent different treatment contexts, and the three-times-per-week regimen has a distinct day-11 post-dose interval. Input sufficiency for a time-course model remains UNRESOLVED without numerical assessment here.
findings.needed_material: Verified regimen-specific dosing and sampling histories and experimental-unit definitions; downstream animal PK assessment of whether these summaries support the requested model objective.

findings.reason: Body rows provide 5, 20 and 40 mg/kg/day and a separate 40 mg/kg three-times/wk regimen, with day-11 and day-23 summaries. These provide candidate dose and treatment-context coverage, but complete preceding dose histories and matched within-dose time courses are NOT_FOUND. Differences between dosing schedules and post-treatment samples do not establish a nonlinear mechanism, time-dependent clearance or estimability.
findings.needed_material: Clarified dosing calendar, treatment-day origins and matching concentration-time records where available; retain mechanism and identifiability questions for the animal PK module.

findings.reason: MI006 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk. For DR11, F0003:S1:T8:A96 specifies means ± standard deviations from six mice at each time point. No animal identifiers, individual measurements, cross-time identity or serial/destructive sampling definition are supplied. These SDs describe group concentration variability; they do not establish individual PK random effects or uncertainty in fitted PK parameters. Independently supported group-summary preparation remains available.
findings.needed_material: Verified individual-level PK records and sampling structure for any proposed individual-variability analysis, or an explicit downstream statement that individual PK variability is unsupported. Assess parameter uncertainty separately and preserve MI006 until its responsible gate records an outcome.

findings.reason: The page contributes mouse concentration-summary and infection-context information only. F0003:S1:T8:A94 explicitly states 'weight not reported' and describes grapefruit-juice exposure. No PK parameter estimates, normalization definitions for such parameters or translation calibration inputs appear. These infected, grapefruit-juice-exposed animals cannot be treated as interchangeable with other mouse contexts.
findings.needed_material: Actual study body weight if required by the considered scaling approach, a separately reviewed parameter inventory and an explicit comparability assessment preserving infection, grapefruit juice, serum bioassay, regimen and sampling context. Do not substitute typical weights.

findings.reason: A95 and A96 repeat dosing values also present in A98:A101; A96 repeats sampling days represented in B97 and C97. These text-derived values remain separately listed for confirmation. The source does not establish additional animals or observations through these repetitions.
findings.needed_material: Preparation review of the separate stated-value list and its source-supported relationships to table rows; record duplicate occurrences without adding measurements or adopting conflicting timeline statements.
